page.overview:
What is Elboron?

Elboron was born sometime after the War of the Ring. He succeeded his father Faramir as Prince of Ithilien, Lord of Emyn Arnen, and the Steward of Gondor, after the death of his father in FO 82.

It is possible that Elboron was the father of Barahir, the grandson of Faramir and author of The Tale of Aragorn and Arwen.

The name Elboron was once given to the son of Dior.
